Author: Javier
Message:
chore: initialize project structure with essential configuration files (#48)

* chore: initialize project structure with essential configuration files

- Added .editorconfig for consistent coding styles across editors.
- Created .env.example with environment variable placeholders for configuration.
- Introduced .gitignore to exclude sensitive files and build artifacts.
- Set up initial ESLint configuration for code quality checks.
- Established Next.js configuration and TypeScript settings.
- Included vitest configuration for unit testing.
- Added components.json for UI component settings.
- Created postcss.config.mjs for Tailwind CSS integration.
- Initialized package.json with project dependencies and scripts.

This commit lays the groundwork for the Coffee project, ensuring a standardized development environment.

* feat: enhance project configuration and add Coffee database support

- Updated .env.example with environment variables for Clerk and Coffee DB.
- Modified .gitignore to include database backup files.
- Enhanced ESLint configuration to ignore archived files.
- Updated package.json with new scripts for database management and added dependencies for Clerk and Prisma.
- Introduced Docker Compose setup for Coffee Postgres database.
- Created Prisma configuration and initial database schema for user management.
- Added API routes for user authentication and onboarding status.
- Implemented middleware for Clerk authentication and updated app routing.

This commit establishes foundational support for user management and database interactions in the Coffee application.

* feat: update configuration and UI components for improved onboarding experience

- Enhanced .env.example with a new variable for skipping onboarding.
- Updated next.config.ts to allow remote image patterns from Clerk.
- Modified src/config.ts to include onboarding skip logic based on environment variable.
- Revamped globals.css with new design tokens and improved color scheme for light and dark themes.
- Updated layout.tsx to incorporate the Jura font for better typography.
- Refined various UI components (Chip, WaveGlyph, AppChrome) to align with the new design system.
- Improved responsiveness and accessibility in chat and approval views.
- Adjusted styles in database-unavailable and login views for consistency with the new theme.

This commit enhances the user interface and onboarding process, ensuring a more cohesive experience across the application.

* feat: enhance CI workflow and add TypeScript type checking

- Added a new script for TypeScript type checking in package.json.
- Updated CI workflow to include type checking, linting, unit testing, and building steps.
- Switched to pnpm for package management in CI for improved performance.
- Set environment variables in CI to prevent build failures due to missing configurations.

This commit improves the development workflow by ensuring type safety and streamlining the CI process.
